SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Bohemia' AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "t".bank = 'AB' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(district_average_salary), 2) AS "average_of_district_average_salaries", COUNT(*) AS "number_of_districts" FROM (SELECT "branch_district".district_id, AVG("client_district".a11) AS "district_average_salary" FROM "district" AS "branch_district" INNER JOIN "account" ON "account".district_id = "branch_district".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" ON "disp".account_id = "account".account_id INNER JOIN "client" ON "client".client_id = "disp".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "client_district" ON "client_district".district_id = "client".district_id WHERE "branch_district".a3 = 'east Bohemia' AND "client".birth_date >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "client".birth_date < DATE '1990-01-01' GROUP BY "branch_district".district_id) AS "district_averages" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(district_avg_salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary" FROM (SELECT "d".district_id, AVG("d".a11) AS "district_avg_salary" FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "c".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "c".client_id IN (SELECT "od".client_id FROM "disp" AS "od" WHERE "od".type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY "od".client_id) AND "c".client_id NOT IN (SELECT "od".client_id FROM "disp" AS "od" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "ad" ON "ad".account_id = "od".account_id INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "ad".disp_id WHERE "od".type = 'OWNER') GROUP BY "d".district_id) AS "district_salaries" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("l".loan_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_loans_per_account" FROM (SELECT "d".account_id FROM "disp" AS "d" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id WHERE "d".type = 'OWNER' AND "c".birth_date < DATE '1950-01-01') AS "older_owner_accounts" LEFT JOIN (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count" FROM "loan" GROUP BY account_id) AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "older_owner_accounts".account_id LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO') AS "household_payments", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND "t".k_symbol <> 'SIPO') AS "other_purpose_payments" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "t".account_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'M' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c".birth_date) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976 AND "t".amount > 4000 LIMIT 501

WITH "borrowing" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, SUM("l".amount) AS "total_borrowed" FROM "loan" AS "l" GROUP BY "l".account_id), "outside_counterparties" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "t".account) AS "counterparty_count" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU') AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".account_id), "households" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date, "b".total_borrowed, COALESCE("o".counterparty_count, 0) AS "counterparty_count", "home".a2 AS "owner_home_district", "home".a10 AS "district_population" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "borrowing" AS "b" ON "b".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "branch" ON "branch".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".account_id = "a".account_id AND "d".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "d".client_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "home" ON "home".district_id = "c".district_id LEFT JOIN "outside_counterparties" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "branch".a2 = 'Prachatice') SELECT account_id, date, total_borrowed, counterparty_count, owner_home_district, district_population, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY district_population DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "households" ORDER BY district_population DESC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_avg" AS (SELECT "account_id", AVG("balance") AS "avg_balance" FROM "trans" GROUP BY "account_id"), "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c"."gender", "a"."district_id" FROM "card" AS "cd" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp"."disp_id" = "cd"."disp_id" AND "owner_disp"."type" = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c"."client_id" = "owner_disp"."client_id" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a"."account_id" = "owner_disp"."account_id" INNER JOIN "account_avg" AS "aa" ON "aa"."account_id" = "a"."account_id" AND "aa".avg_balance > 1000 INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d"."district_id" = "a"."district_id" WHERE "cd"."type" = 'gold' AND "d"."a4"::BIGINT > 100000), "district_metrics" AS (SELECT "qd"."gender", "d"."district_id", "d"."a4"::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d"."a11" AS "salary", "d"."a10" AS "urban_ratio" FROM "qualifying_districts" AS "qd" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d"."district_id" = "qd"."district_id"), "gender_summary" AS (SELECT "gender", COUNT(*) AS "district_count", MAX(inhabitants) AS "max_inhabitants", ROUND(AVG(salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_salary", ROUND(AVG(urban_ratio)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_urban_ratio" FROM "district_metrics" GROUP BY "gender") SELECT CASE "gs"."gender" WHEN 'F' THEN 'women' WHEN 'M' THEN 'men' END AS "gender", "gs".district_count, "dm"."district_id", "dm".inhabitants, "gs".average_salary, "gs".average_urban_ratio FROM "gender_summary" AS "gs" INNER JOIN "district_metrics" AS "dm" ON "dm"."gender" = "gs"."gender" AND "dm".inhabitants = "gs".max_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE "gs"."gender" WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC, "dm"."district_id" ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "a".account_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".account_id = "a".account_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "c" ON "c".disp_id = "owner_disp".disp_id AND "c".type = 'gold' WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 250000), "pair_totals" AS (SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payments", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" ON "qa".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account), "ranked" AS (SELECT pair_totals.*, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS "amount_rank" FROM "pair_totals") SELECT bank, account, outgoing_payments, total_amount FROM "ranked" WHERE amount_rank <= 1 ORDER BY bank ASC, account ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN "t".k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN "t".amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM("t".amount), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a2 = 'Pisek' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("t".k_symbol) <> '' LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "c".client_id, "c".district_id FROM "client" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "owner_disp" ON "owner_disp".client_id = "c".client_id AND "owner_disp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "card" AS "ca" ON "ca".disp_id = "owner_disp".disp_id INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "owner_disp".account_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F'), "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a8 AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "salary", "d".a12 AS "unemployment_1996" FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "e".district_id), "district_ranked" AS (SELECT q.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name ASC) AS "rn" FROM "qualifying_districts" AS "q") SELECT region, ROUND(AVG(salary)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_district_salary", ROUND(AVG(unemployment_1996)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_1996_district_unemployment_rate", MAX(district_name) FILTER (WHERE rn = 1) AS "most_populous_district" FROM "district_ranked" GROUP BY region ORDER BY region ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "pop" AS (SELECT district_id, a2 AS "district_name", a4::NUMERIC AS "inhabitants" FROM "district" WHERE a3 = 'central Bohemia'), "top_three" AS (SELECT district_id, district_name FROM "pop" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_name COLLATE "C" ASC LIMIT 3), "crimes" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, COUNT("t".trans_id) AS "crime_count" FROM "district" AS "d" LEFT JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id AND "t".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' GROUP BY "d".district_id), "top_stats" AS (SELECT AVG("c".crime_count::NUMERIC) AS "avg_count" FROM "top_three" AS "tt" INNER JOIN "crimes" AS "c" ON "c".district_id = "tt".district_id), "all_stats" AS (SELECT AVG(crime_count::NUMERIC) AS "avg_count" FROM "crimes") SELECT "tt".district_name, "c".crime_count AS "crime_count_1996", ROUND("ts".avg_count, 2) AS "three_district_average", ROUND("ats".avg_count, 2) AS "all_district_average", ROUND("ts".avg_count - "ats".avg_count, 2) AS "difference" FROM "top_three" AS "tt" INNER JOIN "crimes" AS "c" ON "c".district_id = "tt".district_id CROSS JOIN "top_stats" AS "ts" CROSS JOIN "all_stats" AS "ats" ORDER BY "c".crime_count DESC, "tt".district_name COLLATE "C" ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "card_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ca".type AS "card_type", "cl".district_id FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".disp_id = "ca".disp_id INNER JOIN "client" AS "cl" ON "cl".client_id = "dp".client_id), "ranked" AS (SELECT "cd".card_type, "d".district_id, "d".a2, "d".a8 AS "inhabitants", MIN("d".a8) OVER (PARTITION BY "cd".card_type) AS "min_inhabitants" FROM "card_districts" AS "cd" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "cd".district_id) SELECT card_type, a2 AS "home_district", inhabitants FROM "ranked" WHERE inhabitants = min_inhabitants ORDER BY CASE card_type WHEN 'gold' THEN 1 WHEN 'classic' THEN 2 WHEN 'junior' THEN 3 END ASC, home_district ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "target_region" AS (SELECT a3 FROM "district" WHERE a2 = 'Litomerice'), "opened" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = (SELECT a3 FROM "target_region") AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' AND "a".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "last_tx" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("t".account_id) "t".account_id, "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "opened" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".date < DATE '1997-01-01' ORDER BY "t".account_id ASC, "t".date DESC, "t".trans_id DESC), "district_stats" AS (SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", ROUND(AVG("lt".balance)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_end_1996_balance" FROM "opened" AS "o" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "o".district_id INNER JOIN "last_tx" AS "lt" ON "lt".account_id = "o".account_id GROUP BY "d".a2), "region_stats" AS (SELECT ROUND(AVG("lt".balance)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "region_average_end_1996_balance" FROM "opened" AS "o" INNER JOIN "last_tx" AS "lt" ON "lt".account_id = "o".account_id), "top_district" AS (SELECT district_name AS "highest_average_district" FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY average_end_1996_balance DESC, district_name ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT district_name, accounts_opened, average_end_1996_balance, (SELECT region_average_end_1996_balance FROM "region_stats") AS "region_wide_average", (SELECT highest_average_district FROM "top_district") AS "highest_average_district" FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY district_name ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".amount, "d".district_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".loan_id ASC) AS "loan_rank" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "top_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT district_id FROM "ranked_loans" WHERE loan_rank <= 10), "district_stats" AS (SELECT "d".district_id, "d".a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", "d".a11 AS "average_salary" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "top_districts" AS "td" ON "td".district_id = "d".district_id) SELECT district_id, inhabitants, (SELECT AVG(average_salary) FROM "district_stats")::NUMERIC(12, 2) AS "average_salary_across_districts" FROM "district_stats" ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "account_counts" AS (SELECT district_id, COUNT(*) AS "account_count" FROM "account" GROUP BY district_id), "withdrawals" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("t".amount) AS "total_withdrawn" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "t".account_id WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ' GROUP BY "a".district_id), "standing_orders" AS (SELECT "a".district_id, SUM("o".amount) AS "total_standing_order_debit" FROM "account" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "order" AS "o" ON "o".account_id = "a".account_id GROUP BY "a".district_id), "district_metrics" AS (SELECT "d".a2 AS "district_name", "d".a3 AS "region", "d".a4::BIGINT AS "population", "w".total_withdrawn, "w".total_withdrawn::NUMERIC / NULLIF("d".a4::BIGINT, 0) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", COALESCE("s".total_standing_order_debit, 0)::NUMERIC / NULLIF("ac".account_count, 0) AS "avg_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district" AS "d" INNER JOIN "withdrawals" AS "w" ON "w".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "account_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".district_id = "d".district_id LEFT JOIN "standing_orders" AS "s" ON "s".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a4::BIGINT >= 100000) SELECT district_name, region, population, total_withdrawn, ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS "withdrawals_per_inhabitant", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS "rank", ROUND(avg_standing_order_debit_per_account, 2) AS "avg_standing_order_debit_per_account" FROM "district_metrics" ORDER BY rank ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ci" AS (SELECT client_id, district_id AS "home_district_id" FROM "client" WHERE client_id = 3541), "accessible" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "disp".account_id FROM "disp" INNER JOIN "ci" ON "disp".client_id = "ci".client_id), "pop" AS (SELECT district_id, a2 AS "district_name", a3 AS "region", a4::BIGINT AS "inhabitants", a11 AS "average_salary", RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY a3 ORDER BY a4::BIGINT DESC) AS "population_rank" FROM "district"), "regional_clients" AS (SELECT "district".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "client_count" FROM "client" INNER JOIN "district" ON "client".district_id = "district".district_id GROUP BY "district".a3), "most_pop" AS (SELECT region, district_name, inhabitants FROM (SELECT pop.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC) AS "rn" FROM "pop") AS "ranked" WHERE rn = 1), "tx" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_income", SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS "total_expense" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id) SELECT "account".account_id, "account".date, "account".frequency, "pop".district_name, "pop".region, CASE WHEN "pop".district_id = "ci".home_district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "home_district", "pop".average_salary, COALESCE("loan".status, 'none') AS "loan_repayment_status", COALESCE("loan".amount, 0) AS "loan_amount", COALESCE("tx".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", COALESCE("tx".total_income, 0) AS "total_income", COALESCE("tx".total_expense, 0) AS "total_expense", COALESCE("tx".total_income, 0) - COALESCE("tx".total_expense, 0) AS "net_balance", "regional_clients".client_count AS "clients_in_region", "most_pop".district_name AS "most_populous_district", "most_pop".inhabitants AS "most_populous_district_inhabitants", "pop".population_rank AS "account_district_population_rank" FROM "accessible" INNER JOIN "account" ON "account".account_id = "accessible".account_id INNER JOIN "ci" ON TRUE INNER JOIN "pop" ON "pop".district_id = "account".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" ON "loan".account_id = "account".account_id LEFT JOIN "tx" ON "tx".account_id = "account".account_id LEFT JOIN "regional_clients" ON "regional_clients".region = "pop".region LEFT JOIN "most_pop" ON "most_pop".region = "pop".region ORDER BY COALESCE("tx".transaction_count, 0) DESC, "account".account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "account_lending" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date, COALESCE(SUM("l".amount), 0) AS "amount_lent" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'central Bohemia' AND "a".date >= DATE '1996-01-01' GROUP BY "a".account_id, "a".district_id, "a".date), "district_year" AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)::INTEGER AS "year_num", district_id, SUM(amount_lent)::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "lent_per_account" FROM "account_lending" GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date), district_id) SELECT TO_CHAR(MAKE_DATE(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date)::INTEGER, 1, 1), 'YYYY') AS "year", COUNT(*) AS "accounts_opened", SUM("al".amount_lent) AS "total_amount_lent", ROUND(AVG("dy".lent_per_account), 2) AS "avg_district_amount_lent_per_account" FROM "account_lending" AS "al" INNER JOIN "district_year" AS "dy" ON "dy".year_num = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date)::INTEGER AND "dy".district_id = "al".district_id GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date) ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "al".date) ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked_loans" AS (SELECT "l".loan_id, "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "l".amount DESC, "l".date ASC, "l".loan_id ASC) AS "loan_rank" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".duration = 24 AND "a".frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'), "top_loans" AS (SELECT * FROM "ranked_loans" WHERE loan_rank <= 10) SELECT "d".a2 AS "district", "tl".amount AS "approved_amount", "tl".date AS "approval_date", (SELECT "t".balance FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".account_id = "tl".account_id AND "t".date = "tl".date ORDER BY "t".trans_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS "account_balance" FROM "top_loans" AS "tl" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "tl".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id ORDER BY "tl".amount DESC, "tl".date ASC, "tl".loan_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "loan_summary" AS (SELECT "account_id", COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", SUM("amount") AS "total_borrowed" FROM "loan" GROUP BY "account_id"), "card_clients" AS (SELECT "c"."client_id", "c"."gender", "c"."birth_date", "ca"."type" AS "card_type", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "ca"."issued")::INTEGER - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "c"."birth_date")::INTEGER AS "age_at_issue", COALESCE("ls".loan_count, 0) AS "loan_count", COALESCE("ls".total_borrowed, 0) AS "total_borrowed", "d"."a2" AS "district_name", "d"."a11" AS "district_average_salary" FROM "card" AS "ca" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp"."disp_id" = "ca"."disp_id" INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c"."client_id" = "dp"."client_id" LEFT JOIN "loan_summary" AS "ls" ON "ls"."account_id" = "dp"."account_id" LEFT JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d"."district_id" = "c"."district_id" WHERE "ca"."issued" >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "ca"."issued" < DATE '1995-01-01') SELECT "client_id", "gender", "birth_date", card_type, age_at_issue, loan_count, total_borrowed, CASE WHEN loan_count > 0 AND age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower' WHEN loan_count > 0 AND age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower' ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS "borrower_classification", district_name, district_average_salary, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "gender" ORDER BY age_at_issue ASC) AS "age_rank_within_gender" FROM "card_clients" ORDER BY "client_id" ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".a2 AS "branch_name", COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count" FROM "trans" AS "t" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "t".account_id = "a".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id WHERE "d".a3 = 'north Moravia' AND "t".date <= DATE '1998-10-14' AND "t".k_symbol IS NULL GROUP BY "d".a2 ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "t".bank, "t".account, COUNT(*) AS "outgoing_payment_count", SUM("t".amount) AS "total_amount_paid" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "trans" AS "t" ON "t".account_id = "l".account_id WHERE "l".loan_id = 5999 AND "l".date = DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".type = 'VYDAJ' AND "t".date < DATE '1996-01-03' AND "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "t".bank, "t".account ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".account_id) AS "active_loan_accounts" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "loan" AS "l" ON "l".account_id = "a".account_id WHERE "a".district_id = 1 AND "a".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".date <= DATE '1995-12-31' AND "l".status IN ('C', 'D') LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN "k_symbol" = 'UROK' THEN "amount" WHEN "k_symbol" = 'SANKC. UROK' THEN -"amount" END) AS "net_interest_czk" FROM "trans" WHERE "account_id" IN (SELECT "account_id" FROM "disp" WHERE "client_id" = 2823) AND "date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND "k_symbol" IN ('UROK', 'SANKC. UROK') LIMIT 501

WITH "female_loans" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, "l".amount, "l".duration, "l".payments, "l".status, "c".client_id, "c".birth_date, "br".a3 AS "region", "br".a2 AS "branch_district" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "ac" ON "ac".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "br" ON "br".district_id = "ac".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "dp" ON "dp".account_id = "ac".account_id AND "dp".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "client" AS "c" ON "c".client_id = "dp".client_id WHERE "c".gender = 'F'), "ranked" AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS "loan_rank" FROM "female_loans"), "transaction_stats" AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS "transaction_count", SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type = 'PRIJEM') AS "total_deposits" FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id), "region_loan_counts" AS (SELECT "d".a3 AS "region", COUNT(*) AS "region_loan_count" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id GROUP BY "d".a3), "region_salary" AS (SELECT a3 AS "region", ROUND(AVG(a11)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "avg_district_salary" FROM "district" GROUP BY a3) SELECT "x".client_id, "x".amount AS "loan_amount", "x".duration AS "duration_months", ROUND(("x".payments * "x".duration)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_payments", ROUND(("x".payments * "x".duration - "x".amount)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "interest_paid", "x".status AS "loan_status", "x".branch_district, "x".region, COALESCE("ts".transaction_count, 0) AS "transaction_count", ROUND(COALESCE("ts".total_deposits, 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "total_deposits", CASE WHEN COALESCE("ts".total_deposits, 0) > 2 * "x".amount THEN 'High Income' WHEN COALESCE("ts".total_deposits, 0) > "x".amount THEN 'Medium Income' ELSE 'Low Income' END AS "income_category", "rlc".region_loan_count, "rs".avg_district_salary, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "x".birth_date)) AS "completed_age" FROM "ranked" AS "x" LEFT JOIN "transaction_stats" AS "ts" ON "ts".account_id = "x".account_id INNER JOIN "region_loan_counts" AS "rlc" ON "rlc".region = "x".region INNER JOIN "region_salary" AS "rs" ON "rs".region = "x".region WHERE "x".loan_rank <= 3 ORDER BY "x".amount DESC LIMIT 501

WITH "qualifying_accounts" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, "d".a3 AS "region" FROM "loan" AS "l" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "l".account_id INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id WHERE "l".duration > 24 AND "l".date < DATE '1997-01-01'), "qualifying_districts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".district_id, "d".a3 AS "region" FROM "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".a3 = "qa".region INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".district_id = "d".district_id INNER JOIN "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa2" ON "qa2".account_id = "a".account_id AND "qa2".region = "d".a3), "region_stats" AS (SELECT "qd".region, COUNT(*) AS "district_count", SUM("d".a4::BIGINT) AS "combined_population", COUNT(DISTINCT "qa".account_id) AS "account_count" FROM "qualifying_districts" AS "qd" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "qd".district_id INNER JOIN "qualifying_accounts" AS "qa" ON "qa".region = "qd".region GROUP BY "qd".region) SELECT region, district_count, combined_population, account_count FROM "region_stats" ORDER BY combined_population DESC, region ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "gold_accounts" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".account_id FROM "card" AS "c" INNER JOIN "disp" AS "d" ON "d".disp_id = "c".disp_id WHERE "c".type = 'gold'), "tx" AS (SELECT "t".account_id, SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'PRIJEM') AS "total_amount_received", SUM("t".amount) FILTER (WHERE "t".type = 'VYDAJ') AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COUNT(DISTINCT "t".bank || ':' || "t".account::TEXT) FILTER (WHERE "t".bank IS NOT NULL AND "t".account IS NOT NULL AND "t".account <> 0 AND "t".operation IN ('PREVOD NA UCET', 'PREVOD Z UCTU')) AS "external_counterparties" FROM "trans" AS "t" GROUP BY "t".account_id), "loans" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "number_of_loans" FROM "loan" AS "l" GROUP BY "l".account_id), "metrics" AS (SELECT "ga".account_id, "district".a2 AS "district_name", "district".a3 AS "region", COALESCE("tx".total_amount_received, 0) AS "total_amount_received", COALESCE("tx".total_amount_withdrawn, 0) AS "total_amount_withdrawn", COALESCE("loans".number_of_loans, 0) AS "number_of_loans", COALESCE("tx".external_counterparties, 0) AS "external_counterparties" FROM "gold_accounts" AS "ga" INNER JOIN "account" AS "a" ON "a".account_id = "ga".account_id INNER JOIN "district" ON "district".district_id = "a".district_id LEFT JOIN "tx" ON "tx".account_id = "ga".account_id LEFT JOIN "loans" ON "loans".account_id = "ga".account_id) SELECT account_id, district_name, region, total_amount_received, total_amount_withdrawn, number_of_loans, external_counterparties, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC) AS "rank" FROM "metrics" ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "a".account_id, "a".date AS "opened_date", "c".gender, "c".birth_date, "d".a2, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "ca".issued <= DATE '1996-12-31' THEN "ca".card_id END) AS "card_count" FROM "account" AS "a" INNER JOIN "district" AS "d" ON "d".district_id = "a".district_id INNER JOIN "disp" AS "ow" ON "ow".account_id = "a".account_id AND "ow".type = 'OWNER' INNER JOIN "c".gender, "c".birth_date, "d".a2), "loan_stats" AS (SELECT "l".account_id, COUNT(*) AS "loan_count", CASE WHEN BOOL_OR("l".status = 'B') THEN 'defaulted' WHEN BOOL_OR("l".status IN ('C', 'D')) THEN COALESCE(MAX("t".balance), 0) AS "peak_balance" FROM "trans" AS "t" WHERE "t".date >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "t".date < DATE '1998-01-01' GROUP BY "t".account_id), "profiles" AS (SELECT "e".account_id, "e".opened_date, "e".gender, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '1996-12-31', "e".birth_date))::INTEGER AS "age_years", "e".card_count, COALESCE("ls".loan_count, 0) AS "loan_count", CASE WHEN "ls".account_id "ac".account_id = "e".account_id) SELECT account_id, opened_date, gender, age_years, card_count, loan_count, loan_standing, transaction_count, money_in, money_out, peak_balance, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance DESC) AS "peak_balance_rank" FROM "profiles" ORDER BY peak_balance_rank ASC, account_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname, "q".q3 AS "fastest_q3_lap_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d2" ON "q2".driverid = "d2".driverid WHERE "d2".nationality = 'Italian' AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 <> '') ORDER BY "d".surname ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_full_name", "r".name AS "race_name", "r".year AS "race_year", "q".q3 AS "q3_time" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "d".nationality = 'British' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "d".dob) > 1980 AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 <> '' AND CAST(SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 1) AS NUMERIC) * 60 + CAST(SPLIT_PART("q".q3, ':', 2) AS NUMERIC) = 64.424 LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "q".q3 ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "constructor_season_points" AS (SELECT "cs".constructorid, "r".year, "cs".points, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "cs".constructorid, "r".year ORDER BY "r".round DESC, "cs".constructorstandingsid DESC) AS "season_row" FROM "constructorstandings" AS "cs" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "cs".raceid), "career" AS (SELECT "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url, COALESCE(SUM("csp".points) FILTER (WHERE "csp".season_row = 1), 0) AS "career_points" FROM "constructors" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "constructor_season_points" AS "csp" ON "csp".constructorid = "c".constructorid WHERE "c".nationality = 'Italian' GROUP BY "c".constructorid, "c".name, "c".url), "ranked" AS (SELECT name, career_points, url, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY career_points DESC) AS "career_rank" FROM "career") SELECT name, career_points, url FROM "ranked" WHERE career_rank <= 3 ORDER BY career_rank ASC, name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "q".driverid) AS "driver_count" FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 1995 AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q1 LIKE '%:%' AND split_part("q".q1, ':', 1)::INTEGER * 60 + split_part(split_part("q".q1, ':', 2), '.', 1)::INTEGER + ('0.' || split_part("q".q1, '.', 2))::NUMERIC > 120 LIMIT 501

WITH "september_races" AS (SELECT "r".raceid, "r".name AS "race_name", "c".name AS "circuit_name", "c".location AS "circuit_location" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".date >= DATE '2016-09-01' AND "r".date < DATE '2016-10-01'), "stops" AS (SELECT "p".driverid, "p".raceid, "p".duration, "p".milliseconds, "sr".race_name, "sr".circuit_name, "sr".circuit_location, MIN("p".milliseconds) OVER () AS "fastest_ms" FROM "pitstops" AS "p" INNER JOIN "september_races" AS "sr" ON "sr".raceid = "p".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "p".driverid WHERE "p".milliseconds IS NOT NULL) SELECT "d".forename || ' ' || "d".surname AS "driver_full_name", "s".duration AS "pit_stop_time", "s".race_name, "s".circuit_name, "s".circuit_location FROM "stops" AS "s" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "s".driverid WHERE "s".milliseconds = "s".fastest_ms LIMIT 501

WITH "winning_drivers" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "d".driverid, "d".forename, "d".surname, "d".nationality, "d".dob FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid WHERE "r".position = 1 AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017), "selected_driver" AS (SELECT driverid, forename, surname, nationality FROM "winning_drivers" ORDER BY dob ASC, forename ASC, surname ASC LIMIT 1), "first_win" AS (SELECT "ra".name, "ra".date FROM "results" AS "r" INNER JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "selected_driver" AS "sd" ON "sd".driverid = "r".driverid WHERE "r".position = 1 AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 ORDER BY "ra".date ASC, "ra".name ASC LIMIT 1) SELECT "sd".forename || ' ' || "sd".surname AS "full_name", "sd".nationality, "fw".name AS "first_race_won", "fw".date AS "first_win_date", COUNT("r".resultid) AS "races_started" FROM "selected_driver" AS "sd" CROSS JOIN "first_win" AS "fw" LEFT JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "sd".driverid LEFT JOIN "races" AS "ra" ON "ra".raceid = "r".raceid AND "ra".year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017 GROUP BY "sd".forename, "sd".surname, "sd".nationality, "fw".name, "fw".date LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "r".raceid) AS "runnings_with_accident_retirement" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "status" AS "s" ON "s".statusid = "res".statusid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "s".status = 'Accident' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".surname, "r".name FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "q".q2 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 = (SELECT MIN("qx".q2) FROM "qualifying" AS "qx" INNER JOIN "races" AS "rx" ON "rx".raceid = "qx".raceid WHERE "rx".year = 2017 AND "qx".q2 IS NOT NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "q".q3 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "d".code, "q".q3 FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "q".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "q".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 <> '' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r2" ON "q2".raceid = "r2".raceid WHERE "r2".year = 2017 AND "r2".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q2".q3 <> '') LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "d".nationality FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 = (SELECT MIN("q2".q3) FROM "qualifying" AS "q2" WHERE "q2".raceid = "q".raceid AND "q2".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q2".q3 LIKE '%:%') AND "q".q3 LIKE '%:%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".code FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "d".code ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "r".year, "d".forename, "d".surname, "res".time FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid INNER JOIN "results" AS "res" ON "res".raceid = "r".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "res".driverid WHERE "r".name = 'Canadian Grand Prix' AND "r".year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017 AND "r".time IS NOT NULL AND "r".time <= '17:00:00' AND "res".position = 1 ORDER BY "r".year ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".number, "d".surname FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".position <= 10 AND "q".q3 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q3 < '1:38.000' LIMIT 501

WITH "race_times" AS (SELECT "c".circuitref, "r".time::TIME AS "start_time" FROM "races" AS "r" INNER JOIN "circuits" AS "c" ON "c".circuitid = "r".circuitid WHERE "r".time IS NOT NULL), "extremes" AS (SELECT MIN(start_time) AS "earliest_time", MAX(start_time) AS "latest_time" FROM "race_times") SELECT (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY circuitref ASC) FROM "race_times" WHERE start_time = "extremes".earliest_time) AS "earliest_circuitrefs", (SELECT STRING_AGG(DISTINCT circuitref, ', ' ORDER BY circuitref ASC) FROM "race_times" WHERE start_time = "extremes".latest_time) AS "latest_circuitrefs", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("extremes".latest_time - "extremes".earliest_time))::BIGINT AS "gap_seconds" FROM "extremes" LIMIT 501

SELECT "d".forename, "d".surname FROM "drivers" AS "d" INNER JOIN "results" AS "r" ON "r".driverid = "d".driverid WHERE "d".dob >= DATE '1980-01-01' AND "d".dob < DATE '1991-01-01' AND "r".fastestlapspeed IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST("r".fastestlapspeed AS NUMERIC) DESC, "d".dob ASC, "d".surname ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT "d".driverref FROM "qualifying" AS "q" INNER JOIN "races" AS "r" ON "r".raceid = "q".raceid INNER JOIN "drivers" AS "d" ON "d".driverid = "q".driverid WHERE "r".year = 2017 AND "r".name = 'Italian Grand Prix' AND "q".q1 IS NOT NULL AND "q".q2 IS NULL ORDER BY "q".q1 DESC, "d".driverid ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "results".driverid) FROM "results" INNER JOIN "races" ON "results".raceid = "races".raceid INNER JOIN "status" ON "results".statusid = "status".statusid WHERE "races".year = 1962 AND "races".name = 'British Grand Prix' AND "status".status = 'Withdrew' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_total)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "mean_total_expense_per_event" FROM (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("x".cost) AS "event_total" FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "x".link_to_member = "m".member_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "m".first_name = 'Elijah' AND "m".last_name = 'Allen' AND "x".expense_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "x".expense_date < '2019-11-01' GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) AS "event_expenses" LIMIT 501

SELECT (COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' THEN "b".spent END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "e".event_date >= '2020-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2021-01-01' THEN "b".spent END), 0)) AS "difference" FROM "budget" AS "b" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LIMIT 501
SELECT notes FROM "income" WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name HAVING SUM("b".spent) / NULLIF(SUM("b".amount), 0) = (SELECT MAX(event_ratio) FROM (SELECT SUM("b2".spent) / NULLIF(SUM("b2".amount), 0) AS "event_ratio" FROM "event" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b2" ON "b2".link_to_event = "e2".event_id WHERE "e2".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e2".event_id) AS "ratios") LIMIT 501

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "attendance" AS "a" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') AS "soccer_count", (SELECT ROUND(AVG(n)::NUMERIC, 1) FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "n" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2019-12-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "t") AS "semester_average" LIMIT 501

WITH "event_attendance" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".type, COUNT("a".link_to_member) AS "attendance_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-01-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-01-01' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".type), "event_budget" AS (SELECT "b".link_to_event, SUM("b".amount) AS "budget_amount" FROM "budget" AS "b" GROUP BY "b".link_to_event) SELECT "ea".type AS "event_type", SUM("ea".attendance_count) AS "members_attended", COALESCE(SUM("eb".budget_amount), 0) AS "total_budgeted_amount" FROM "event_attendance" AS "ea" LEFT JOIN "event_budget" AS "eb" ON "eb".link_to_event = "ea".event_id GROUP BY "ea".type ORDER BY "ea".type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".location, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".type = 'Budget' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".major_id IS NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "major" AS "mj" LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT link_to_major AS "major_id" FROM "member" WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL) AS "m" ON "m".major_id = "mj".major_id LIMIT 501

WITH "member_counts" AS (SELECT "m".member_id, "m".position, COUNT("a".link_to_event) AS "attended" FROM "member" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_member = "m".member_id GROUP BY "m".member_id, "m".position) SELECT ROUND(AVG(attended::NUMERIC) FILTER (WHERE position IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer')), 2) AS "average_events_per_officer", ROUND(AVG(attended::NUMERIC) FILTER (WHERE position NOT IN ('President', 'Vice President', 'Secretary', 'Treasurer') OR position IS NULL), 2) AS "average_events_per_other_student" FROM "member_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "ev".event_name, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM("ex".cost), 0)::NUMERIC / COUNT(DISTINCT "att".link_to_member), 2) AS "amount_spent_per_attendee" FROM "event" AS "ev" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "att" ON "att".link_to_event = "ev".event_id LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "bu" ON "bu".link_to_event = "ev".event_id LEFT JOIN "expense" AS "ex" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "bu".budget_id AND "ex".expense_description ILIKE 'Water%' GROUP BY "ev".event_id, "ev".event_name LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".college ILIKE '%Humanities and Social Sciences%') AS "members_in_college_departments", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "m".college IS NULL OR "m".college NOT ILIKE '%Humanities and Social Sciences%') AS "members_not_in_college_departments" FROM "member" AS "r" LEFT JOIN "major" AS "m" ON "r".link_to_major = "m".major_id LIMIT 501

WITH "chip_budgets" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "b".link_to_event, "b".amount FROM "expense" AS "x" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "x".expense_description ILIKE '%chips%'), "event_max" AS (SELECT link_to_event, MAX(amount) AS "max_line_amount" FROM "chip_budgets" GROUP BY link_to_event) SELECT "e".event_name FROM "event_max" AS "m" INNER JOIN "event" AS "e" ON "e".event_id = "m".link_to_event WHERE "m".max_line_amount = (SELECT MAX(max_line_amount) FROM "event_max") LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_date AS "most_recent_expense_date", SUM("e".cost) AS "total_cost" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m" ON "e".link_to_member = "m".member_id WHERE "m".position = 'Vice President' AND "e".expense_date = (SELECT MAX("e2".expense_date) FROM "expense" AS "e2" INNER JOIN "member" AS "m2" ON "e2".link_to_member = "m2".member_id WHERE "m2".position = 'Vice President') GROUP BY "e".expense_date LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".type, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "attendee_count" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".location = 'MU 215' GROUP BY "e".type ORDER BY "e".type ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "college_counts" AS (SELECT "major".college, COUNT(DISTINCT "major".major_name) AS "major_count" FROM "member" INNER JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id WHERE "major".college IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "major".college), "ranked" AS (SELECT college, major_count, MAX(major_count) OVER () AS "top_count" FROM "college_counts") SELECT college, major_count FROM "ranked" WHERE major_count = top_count ORDER BY college ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".location AS "location", COUNT(DISTINCT "x".expense_description) AS "number_of_different_things_bought" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".amount > 40 GROUP BY "e".location LIMIT 501

SELECT SUM("b".amount) AS "total_budgeted" FROM "event" AS "ev" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "ev".event_id INNER JOIN "budget" AS "pizza_budget" ON "pizza_budget".link_to_event = "ev".event_id INNER JOIN "expense" AS "ex" ON "ex".link_to_budget = "pizza_budget".budget_id WHERE "ev".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "ev".event_date < '2019-10-01' AND "ex".expense_description = 'Pizza' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(event_spent)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_spent_per_event" FROM (SELECT "e".event_id, COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "event_spent" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".event_id) AS "event_totals" LIMIT 501

WITH "event_totals" AS (SELECT "e".event_id, "e".event_name, COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_budget", COALESCE(SUM("b".spent), 0) AS "total_spending" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".status = 'Closed' GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name), "eligible" AS (SELECT event_id, event_name FROM "event_totals" WHERE total_spending <= total_budget), "purchase_counts" AS (SELECT "el".event_id, "el".event_name, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "x".expense_description IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 + length("x".expense_description) - length(replace("x".expense_description, ',', '')) END), 0) AS "purchases" FROM "eligible" AS "el" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "el".event_id LEFT JOIN "expense" AS "x" ON "x".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id GROUP BY "el".event_id, "el".event_name) SELECT event_name FROM "purchase_counts" ORDER BY purchases DESC, event_id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH "attended" AS (SELECT "e"."type", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "member_count" FROM "event" AS "e" INNER JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id WHERE "e".event_date >= '2019-09-01' AND "e".event_date < '2020-06-01' GROUP BY "e"."type"), "ranked" AS (SELECT "type", member_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY member_count DESC) AS "r" FROM "attended") SELECT "type", member_count FROM "ranked" WHERE r = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".expense_description, COUNT(*) AS "record_count" FROM "expense" AS "e" INNER JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "e".link_to_budget = "b".budget_id WHERE "b".category = 'Food' GROUP BY "e".expense_description ORDER BY record_count DESC, "e".expense_description ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT "e".event_name, "e".event_date, COALESCE(SUM("b".amount), 0) AS "total_amount_budgeted", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".link_to_member) AS "number_of_members_attended" FROM "event" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "budget" AS "b" ON "b".link_to_event = "e".event_id LEFT JOIN "attendance" AS "a" ON "a".link_to_event = "e".event_id GROUP BY "e".event_id, "e".event_name, "e".event_date ORDER BY "e".event_name ASC, "e".event_date ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "expense".expense_description AS "item_name", COUNT(*) AS "times_bought" FROM "expense" INNER JOIN "member" ON "expense".link_to_member = "member".member_id WHERE "member".first_name = 'Sacha' AND "member".last_name = 'Harrison' GROUP BY "expense".expense_description ORDER BY "expense".expense_description ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "major".major_name) FROM "member" INNER JOIN "major" ON "member".link_to_major = "major".major_id WHERE "major".department = 'Political Science Department' LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT("s".id) AS "hero_count", RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT("s".id) DESC) AS "rank" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "c".colour <> 'No Colour' GROUP BY "c".colour ORDER BY hero_count DESC, eye_colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "sp".power_name = 'Super Strength' ORDER BY "s".superhero_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "Neutral percentage", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Neutral' AND "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "Neutral Marvel superheroes" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".publisher_name, COUNT("s".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name IN ('Marvel Comics', 'DC Comics') GROUP BY "p".publisher_name LIMIT 501
SELECT "s".superhero_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND "c".colour = 'No Colour' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "s".height_cm BETWEEN 150 AND 180 AND "s".height_cm <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "p".publisher_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "eye" ON "s".eye_colour_id = "eye".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "hair" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "hair".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "skin" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "skin".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "eye".colour IS NOT NULL AND "hair".colour IS NOT NULL AND "skin".colour IS NOT NULL AND "eye".colour <> 'No Colour' AND "hair".colour <> 'No Colour' AND "skin".colour <> 'No Colour' AND "eye".colour = "hair".colour AND "hair".colour = "skin".colour LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "skin_colour".colour = 'Blue') / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" INNER JOIN "gender" ON "superhero".gender_id = "gender".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "skin_colour" ON "superhero".skin_colour_id = "skin_colour".id WHERE "gender".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "dc".hero_count > "marvel".hero_count THEN 'DC Comics' WHEN "marvel".hero_count > "dc".hero_count THEN 'Marvel Comics' ELSE 'Tie' END AS "publisher", ABS("dc".hero_count - "marvel".hero_count) AS "difference" FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') AS "dc" CROSS JOIN (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "hero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "marvel" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".height_cm) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm > 0 AND "sp".power_name NOT IN (SELECT "dsp".power_name FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dp" ON "dp".id = "dc".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "dhp" ON "dhp".hero_id = "dc".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "dsp" ON "dsp".id = "dhp".power_id WHERE "dp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM (SELECT "hp".power_id FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hps" ON "hps".hero_id = "hp".hero_id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "strength" ON "strength".id = "hps".power_id WHERE "strength".power_name = 'Super Strength' GROUP BY "hp".power_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".hero_id) = COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "hp".hero_id = "hps".hero_id THEN "hp".hero_id END) AND COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".hero_id) = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "all_hp".hero_id) FROM "hero_power" AS "all_hp" WHERE "all_hp".power_id = "hp".power_id)) AS "exclusive_powers" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Green' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "a".alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad') LIMIT 501

WITH "known_marvel" AS (SELECT "s".id FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM("s".full_name) <> '' AND "s".full_name <> '-'), "power_counts" AS (SELECT "sp".power_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "hm".id) AS "hero_count" FROM "known_marvel" AS "hm" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "hm".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id GROUP BY "sp".power_name) SELECT power_name, hero_count FROM "power_counts" WHERE hero_count = (SELECT MAX(hero_count) FROM "power_counts") ORDER BY power_name ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC(10, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ab_attr" ON "ab_attr".attribute_id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "ab_a" ON "ab_a".id = "ab_attr".attribute_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "ab" ON "ab".id = "ab_attr".hero_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "ab_a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "ab".superhero_name = 'Abomination' AND "ha".attribute_value = "ab_attr".attribute_value AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, COUNT("q".id) AS "superhero_count" FROM "gender" AS "g" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "s".id, "s".gender_id FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".hair_colour_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue' GROUP BY "s".id, "s".gender_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) >= 10) AS "q" ON "q".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') GROUP BY "g".gender LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg))::INTEGER AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Strength' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT "hulk_attribute".attribute_value FROM "superhero" AS "hulk" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "hulk_attribute" ON "hulk_attribute".hero_id = "hulk".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "strength" ON "strength".id = "hulk_attribute".attribute_id WHERE "hulk".superhero_name = 'Hulk' AND "strength".attribute_name = 'Strength') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "s".height_cm = (SELECT height_cm FROM "superhero" WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL ORDER BY height_cm DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9) OR "s".height_cm > (SELECT height_cm FROM "superhero" WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL ORDER BY height_cm DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("dc".weight_kg)) FROM "superhero" AS "dc" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "dcp" ON "dc".publisher_id = "dcp".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "dce" ON "dc".eye_colour_id = "dce".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT "mve".colour FROM "superhero" AS "mv" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "mvp" ON "mv".publisher_id = "mvp".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "mve" ON "mv".eye_colour_id = "mve".id WHERE "mvp".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') AS "marvel_eye" ON "marvel_eye".colour = "dce".colour WHERE "dcp".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "dc".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("s".weight_kg) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "r".id = "s".race_id INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "r".race IN (SELECT "r2".race FROM "superhero" AS "s2" INNER JOIN "race" AS "r2" ON "r2".id = "s2".race_id GROUP BY "r2".race HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "s2".gender_id = (SELECT id FROM "gender" WHERE gender = 'Female')) = 0) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "s".publisher_id) AS "publisher_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" WHERE "s".height_cm > 200 AND "s".publisher_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id LEFT JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good' AND ("p".publisher_name <> 'DC Comics' OR "p".publisher_name IS NULL) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg", COUNT(*) AS "superhero_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'DC Comics' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
