SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg), 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("ha".attribute_value)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_intelligence_score" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Intelligence' AND "sp".power_name IN ('Super Speed', 'Death Touch') LIMIT 501

SELECT "g".gender, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("p".power_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "average_superpowers_per_hero" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "g".id = "s".gender_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT "hp".hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" GROUP BY "hp".hero_id) AS "p" ON "p".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender IN ('Male', 'Female') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' AND "s".full_name ~ '[[:alpha:]]+[[:space:]]+[[:alpha:]]+' GROUP BY "g".gender ORDER BY CASE "g".gender WHEN 'Male' THEN 1 WHEN 'Female' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".height_cm) FILTER (WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm <> 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg) FILTER (WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".height_cm, 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm", ROUND(AVG(NULLIF("s".weight_kg, 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "s".publisher_id = "p".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("other_hero".height_cm)::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_height_cm" FROM "superhero" AS "target" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "target_power" ON "target_power".hero_id = "target".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "shared_power" ON "shared_power".power_id = "target_power".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "other_hero" ON "other_hero".id = "shared_power".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "other_hero".id <> "target".id AND "other_hero".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "other_hero".height_cm <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".skin_colour_id = "c".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "hp".power_id = "sp".id WHERE "a".alignment = 'Bad' AND "c".colour = 'Green' AND "sp".power_name = 'Flight' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'George Lucas' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s".alignment_id = "a".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Female' AND "a".alignment = 'Good' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hp".power_id) AS "power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "gender" AS "g" ON "s".gender_id = "g".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "g".gender = 'Male' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 AND "s".weight_kg < 70 LIMIT 501

SELECT "c".colour FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "race" AS "r" ON "s".race_id = "r".id LEFT JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "s".hair_colour_id = "c".id WHERE "s".height_cm IS NOT NULL AND "s".height_cm > 0 AND "r".race = 'Human' ORDER BY "s".height_cm ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(MAX("power_counts".power_count), 0) AS "max_power_count" FROM "superhero" AS "s" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "hp".hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "sp".power_name) AS "power_count" FROM "hero_power" AS "hp" INNER JOIN "superpower" AS "sp" ON "sp".id = "hp".power_id GROUP BY "hp".hero_id) AS "power_counts" ON "power_counts".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "s".weight_kg = (SELECT MIN(weight_kg) FROM "superhero" WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND weight_kg > 0) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "s"."alignment_id" = "a"."id" WHERE "a"."alignment" = 'Neutral' AND "s"."full_name" IS NOT NULL AND "s"."full_name" <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "s".superhero_name, "s".full_name FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_attribute" AS "ha" ON "ha".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a" ON "a".id = "ha".attribute_id WHERE "a".attribute_name = 'Speed' AND "ha".attribute_value = (SELECT MAX("ha2".attribute_value) FROM "hero_attribute" AS "ha2" INNER JOIN "attribute" AS "a2" ON "a2".id = "ha2".attribute_id WHERE "a2".attribute_name = 'Speed') AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT "eye_colour".colour AS "eye_colour", COUNT(DISTINCT "non_brown".id) AS "count" FROM "colour" AS "brown_hair" INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "brown_hero" ON "brown_hero".hair_colour_id = "brown_hair".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "eye_colour" ON "eye_colour".id = "brown_hero".eye_colour_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "non_brown" ON "non_brown".eye_colour_id = "eye_colour".id INNER JOIN "colour" AS "other_hair" ON "other_hair".id = "non_brown".hair_colour_id WHERE "brown_hair".colour = 'Brown' AND "other_hair".colour <> 'Brown' GROUP BY "eye_colour".colour ORDER BY count DESC, "eye_colour".colour ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".alignment = 'Good') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id LEFT JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' AND "s".full_name IS NOT NULL AND "s".full_name <> '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".alignment = 'Good' THEN "s".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "s".id), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "publisher" AS "p" ON "p".id = "s".publisher_id INNER JOIN "alignment" AS "a" ON "a".id = "s".alignment_id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id WHERE "p".publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("s".weight_kg)::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_weight_kg" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp" ON "hp".hero_id = "s".id INNER JOIN "hero_power" AS "hp3" ON "hp3".power_id = "hp".power_id INNER JOIN "superhero" AS "target" ON "target".id = "hp3".hero_id WHERE "target".superhero_name = '3-D Man' AND "s".superhero_name <> '3-D Man' AND "s".weight_kg IS NOT NULL AND "s".weight_kg <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'No Colour') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "c".colour = 'Blue') AS "difference" FROM "superhero" AS "s" INNER JOIN "colour" AS "c" ON "c".id = "s".eye_colour_id WHERE "s".weight_kg IS NULL OR "s".weight_kg = 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'M' AND "l".ua > 8.0 THEN "p".id END) AS NUMERIC) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".ua > 6.5 THEN "p".id END), 0) AS "male_to_female_ratio" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".alb)::NUMERIC, 4) AS "average_alb" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".plt > 400 AND "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "l".alb IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".tg >= 200 AND "p".birthday < DATE '1976-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".glu >= 180 AND "l"."T-CHO" < 250 AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".hct >= 52) >= 2 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 2) AS "female_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday < DATE '1971-10-09' AND "l".date <= DATE '2026-10-09' AND "l".pt >= 14 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".crp LIKE '%+%' AND "p".description IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM (SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LEFT JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') GROUP BY "p".id HAVING COUNT("e".symptoms) = 0) AS "qualifying_patients" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id), 0), 2) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1930-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1941-01-01' LIMIT 501

WITH "strongest" AS (SELECT MAX(CAST(rnp AS INTEGER)) AS "max_rnp" FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative'), "candidates" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l"."T-BIL", CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) AS "rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" CROSS JOIN "strongest" AS "s" WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) = "s".max_rnp AND "l"."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL), "highest_bilirubin" AS (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") AS "max_bilirubin" FROM "candidates") SELECT "c"."T-BIL" AS "total bilirubin", "c".date AS "date of lab test", "p".id AS "patient ID", "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "candidates" AS "c" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "c".id CROSS JOIN "highest_bilirubin" AS "h" WHERE "c"."T-BIL" = "h".max_bilirubin LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1960-01-01' AND "p".id IN (SELECT "e".id FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".thrombosis = 1) AND "p".id NOT IN (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp IN ('15', '16', '64', '256')) LIMIT 501

SELECT "l".id, CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) AS "anti_rnp_titer" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s" ON "s".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "s".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "s".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0') AND CAST("l".rnp AS INTEGER) = (SELECT MAX(CAST("r".rnp AS INTEGER)) FROM "laboratory" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "rp" ON "rp".id = "r".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "s2" ON "s2".id = "r".id WHERE "rp".admission = '-' AND "r".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "r".rnp <> 'negative' AND "s2".ssa IS NOT NULL AND "s2".ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "platelet_lab" ON "platelet_lab".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "rnp_lab" ON "rnp_lab".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'MCTD' AND "platelet_lab".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "rnp_lab".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "rnp_lab".rnp::INTEGER > 5 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE("lab".date_count, 0)::NUMERIC), 2) AS "avg_laboratory_test_dates" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN (SELECT id, COUNT(DISTINCT date) AS "date_count" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "lab" ON "lab".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id, "l".date, "l".dna FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '+(') AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna <> '' AND "l".dna = (SELECT MAX("l2".dna) FROM "laboratory" AS "l2" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p2" ON "p2".id = "l2".id WHERE "p2".sex = 'F' AND "p2".admission IN ('+', '+(') AND "l2".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l2".dna <> '') ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM (SELECT "p"."id" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "h" ON "h"."id" = "p"."id" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "r" ON "r"."id" = "p"."id" WHERE "p"."admission" = '+' AND "h"."hct" IS NOT NULL AND ("h"."hct" <= 29 OR "h"."hct" >= 52) AND "r"."rnp" IS NOT NULL AND "r"."rnp" <> 'negative' AND "r"."rnp"::INTEGER > 16 GROUP BY "p"."id") AS "qualifying_patients" LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX(CAST(rnp AS INTEGER)) AS "highest_anti_rnp_value" FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE normal_count > 0) AS "with_normal_platelet", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE normal_count = 0) AS "never_normal_platelet" FROM (SELECT "p".id, COUNT("l".plt) FILTER (WHERE "l".plt > 100 AND "l".plt < 400) AS "normal_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('RA,SJS', 'SJS,RA') GROUP BY "p".id) AS "patient_history" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("l".tp - 8.5)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "average_deviation" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "examination" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".tp > 8.5 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1960-01-01') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".alb < 3.5 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 64) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(1999 - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 32 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

SELECT MIN(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date)::INT - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday)::INT) AS "youngest age" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp::INT >= 64 AND "l".date IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT("l".id) AS "total_laboratory_tests", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NULL) AS "patients_with_no_laboratory_tests" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1997-01-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1998-01-01' AND thrombosis > 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms AS "symptom" FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "e".symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, "e".symptoms ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS "percentage" FROM "examination" WHERE thrombosis = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."Examination Date" - "p"."First Date")) AS "average_delay_days" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission LIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."Examination Date" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."Examination Date" = (SELECT MIN("e2"."Examination Date") FROM "examination" AS "e2" WHERE "e2".id = "p".id) AND "p"."First Date" = (SELECT MIN("p2"."First Date") FROM "patient" AS "p2" WHERE "p2".id = "p".id) LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1994-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1995-01-01' AND "l".got < 60 AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id AS "patient_id", EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)) AS "completed_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".ldh > 600 AND "l".ldh < 800 AND ("l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "count_difference" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'RA' AND "l".un < 30 LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) AS "patients_with_out_of_range_creatinine", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "total_patients", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "l".cre >= 1.5 THEN "p".id END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id), 0), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY "p".sex ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "group_max" AS (SELECT "p".admission, MAX("l"."T-CHO") AS "highest_t_cho" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l"."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY "p".admission) SELECT "g".highest_t_cho AS "T-CHO", "p".admission, "p".id FROM "group_max" AS "g" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".admission = "g".admission INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id AND "l"."T-CHO" = "g".highest_t_cho ORDER BY CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".rnp, "l".rnp::INTEGER AS "level" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative') SELECT id, rnp AS "anti_rnp_level" FROM "eligible" WHERE level = (SELECT MAX(level) FROM "eligible") LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG("l".hct) AS "average_hematocrit" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1991-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1992-01-01' AND "l".hct IS NOT NULL AND ("l"."U-PRO" IN ('300', '>=300', '>=1000') OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('4')) LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis = 'SLE' AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY "p".admission ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".ra IN ('-', '+-') AND COALESCE("e".kct, '') <> '+' AND COALESCE("e".rvvt, '') <> '+' AND COALESCE("e".lac, '') <> '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id, MAX(date) AS "most_recent_date" FROM "laboratory" GROUP BY id) AS "latest" ON "latest".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "latest".id AND "l".date = "latest".most_recent_date WHERE "latest".most_recent_date > DATE '1997-01-01' AND "l".sc170 IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE ssa IS NOT NULL AND ssa NOT IN ('negative', '0')) AND id IN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0')) LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna::NUMERIC < 8 LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission <> '-' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".alp >= 300) LIMIT 501
SELECT MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".cre < 1.5 AND "l".cre IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".sex = 'F' THEN 'female' WHEN "p".sex = 'M' THEN 'male' END AS "sex", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND "l".hgb < 7.0 GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT id, date, rnp FROM "laboratory" WHERE got >= 60 AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> 'negative'), "highest" AS (SELECT MAX(rnp::INTEGER) AS "max_rnp" FROM "eligible") SELECT "p".id, "e".date, "e".rnp FROM "eligible" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "e".id CROSS JOIN "highest" AS "h" WHERE "e".rnp::INTEGER = "h".max_rnp LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "eligible_patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday > DATE '1980-01-01' AND ("l".fg < 150 OR "l".fg > 450 OR "l"."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '>=1000')) LIMIT 501

SELECT CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' ELSE 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "patient_group", COUNT(*) AS "measurements_with_ldh_below_500" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') AND "l".ldh < 500 GROUP BY "p".admission ORDER BY CASE WHEN "p".admission = '+' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l".id IS NOT NULL) AS "patients_with_any_laboratory_result", COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FILTER (WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 2.0) AS "patients_with_elevated_total_bilirubin" FROM "patient" AS "p" LEFT JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IS NULL LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday >= DATE '1945-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1990-01-01' AND "p".admission LIKE '+%' AND "e"."ANA Pattern" = 'P' LIMIT 501

WITH "outpatient_anemic" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".hgb < 10), "rnp_max" AS (SELECT MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "max_rnp" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "outpatient_anemic" AS "oa" ON "oa".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative') SELECT "oa".id, "oa".sex, MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) AS "highest_rnp_level" FROM "outpatient_anemic" AS "oa" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "oa".id CROSS JOIN "rnp_max" AS "rm" WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' GROUP BY "oa".id, "oa".sex, "rm".max_rnp HAVING MAX("l".rnp::INTEGER) = "rm".max_rnp LIMIT 501

WITH "first_labs" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, got, rnp FROM "laboratory" ORDER BY id ASC, date ASC) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "first_labs" WHERE got < 60 AND rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp NOT IN ('negative') AND rnp::INTEGER > 10 LIMIT 501

WITH "ranked" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l"."U-PRO" AS "proteinuria_level", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC NULLS LAST) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL) SELECT "p".id, "p".sex, "r".date, "r".proteinuria_level FROM "ranked" AS "r" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "r".id WHERE "r".rn = 1 LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".cpk < 250 AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp::INTEGER > 4 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rnp <> 'negative' AND "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> '0' AND "e".thrombosis = 0 LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp IN ('16', '64', '256') GROUP BY "l".id), "normal_gpt" AS (SELECT "l".id, MAX("l".gpt) AS "highest_normal_gpt" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "eligible" AS "e" ON "e".id = "l".id WHERE "l".gpt < 60 GROUP BY "l".id) SELECT "p".birthday FROM "normal_gpt" AS "n" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "n".id ORDER BY "n".highest_normal_gpt DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".thrombosis = 1 AND "l".pt < 14 AND "l".rnp IN ('16', '64', '256') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".diagnosis, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "l".date) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday) - CASE WHEN TO_CHAR("l".date, 'MMDD') < TO_CHAR("p".birthday, 'MMDD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "age_years" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".admission = '+' AND "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna <> 'negative' ORDER BY "l".dna::NUMERIC DESC, "l".date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l"."T-BIL" >= 1.2 AND "p".diagnosis ~ '(^|[,[:space:]])SLE([,[:space:]]|$)' ORDER BY "p".sex ASC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "eligible" AS (SELECT "p".id, CASE "p".admission WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "care_setting" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "p".birthday <= DATE '1976-10-09' AND "p".admission IN ('+', '-')), "rnp_by_patient" AS (SELECT "l".id, BOOL_OR("l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 4) AS "has_elevated_rnp" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rnp IS NOT NULL AND "l".rnp <> 'negative' GROUP BY "l".id) SELECT "e".care_setting, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE("r".has_elevated_rnp, FALSE)) AS "patients_with_at_least_one_result_at_least_4", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT COALESCE("r".has_elevated_rnp, FALSE)) AS "patients_with_no_such_result" FROM "eligible" AS "e" LEFT JOIN "rnp_by_patient" AS "r" ON "r".id = "e".id GROUP BY "e".care_setting ORDER BY "e".care_setting ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN LATERAL (SELECT "l".igg FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "l".date DESC LIMIT 1) AS "latest" ON TRUE WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "latest".igg >= 2000 LIMIT 501

WITH "sle_patients" AS (SELECT id, diagnosis FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%'), "patient_max" AS (SELECT "p".id, "p".diagnosis, MAX("l".dna::NUMERIC) AS "max_numeric" FROM "sle_patients" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "l".dna IS NOT NULL AND "l".dna ~ '^[0-9]+$' GROUP BY "p".id, "p".diagnosis), "overall_max" AS (SELECT MAX(max_numeric) AS "value" FROM "patient_max") SELECT "pm".id, "pm".diagnosis, MAX("l".dna) AS "highest_anti_dna" FROM "patient_max" AS "pm" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "pm".id CROSS JOIN "overall_max" AS "om" WHERE "pm".max_numeric = "om".value AND "l".dna::NUMERIC = "pm".max_numeric GROUP BY "pm".id, "pm".diagnosis LIMIT 501

WITH "settings" AS (SELECT id, CASE WHEN admission IN ('+', '+(') THEN 'admitted to the hospital' WHEN admission = '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic' END AS "setting" FROM "patient" WHERE admission IN ('+', '+(', '-')), "latest_igg" AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (id) id, igg FROM "laboratory" WHERE igg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id ASC, date DESC) SELECT "s".setting, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "l".igg > 900 AND "l".igg < 2000) / COUNT(*), 1) AS "percentage" FROM "settings" AS "s" LEFT JOIN "latest_igg" AS "l" ON "s".id = "l".id GROUP BY "s".setting ORDER BY "s".setting ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "latest" AS (SELECT "l".id, "l".date, "l".rnp, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "l".id ORDER BY "l".date DESC) AS "rn" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".date IS NOT NULL) SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'M') AS "female_minus_male" FROM "latest" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".rn = 1 AND "l".rnp ~ '^[0-9]+$' AND "l".rnp::INTEGER >= 32 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON ("l".id) "l".id, "l".rnp, "l".cpk FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "l".rnp IN ('64', '256') ORDER BY "l".id ASC, "l".date DESC NULLS LAST) AS "latest" WHERE "latest".rnp = '256' AND "latest".cpk < 250 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+') AS "inpatients", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '-') AS "outpatient_clinic", ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission = '+')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE admission IN ('+', '-')), 0), 2) AS "inpatient_percentage" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis ~ '(^|[, ]+)SLE([, ]|$)' AND diagnosis !~ 'SLE susp' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "p".id, "p".sex, "p".birthday FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "ldh_lab" ON "ldh_lab".id = "p".id AND "ldh_lab".ldh >= 500 INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "protein_lab" ON "protein_lab".id = "p".id WHERE (CASE WHEN "protein_lab"."U-PRO" LIKE '%(%)' THEN NULLIF(split_part(split_part("protein_lab"."U-PRO", '(', 2), ')', 1), '')::INTEGER WHEN left("protein_lab"."U-PRO", 2) = '>=' THEN NULLIF(substr("protein_lab"."U-PRO", 3), '')::INTEGER WHEN "protein_lab"."U-PRO" ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN "protein_lab"."U-PRO"::INTEGER ELSE NULL END) >= 100 ORDER BY "p".id ASC LIMIT 501
SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "examination" AS "e" WHERE "e".id = "p".id) GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" WHERE sex = 'F' AND "First Date" >= DATE '1998-01-01' AND "First Date" < DATE '1999-01-01' AND admission LIKE '+%' LIMIT 501

SELECT "e".symptoms, "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' AND "e".symptoms IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "p".birthday DESC, "p".id ASC, "e"."Examination Date" DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT "p".diagnosis FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".admission ILIKE '%+%' AND "p"."First Date" >= DATE '1998-02-15' AND "p"."First Date" < DATE '1998-03-01' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ("p"."First Date" - "p".birthday) DESC, "p".id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "examination" WHERE "Examination Date" >= DATE '1993-10-01' AND "Examination Date" < DATE '1993-11-01' AND diagnosis ILIKE '%SLE%' AND diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SLE susp%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "patient" WHERE diagnosis IN ('Psoriatic arthritis', 'Psoriatic Arthritis') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".sex IN ('M', 'F') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".gpt >= 60) GROUP BY "p".sex LIMIT 501

WITH "low_rbc_patients" AS (SELECT DISTINCT "l".id FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".rbc < 3.5) SELECT "p".admission, COUNT(*) AS "patient_count", ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM DATE '2026-10-09') - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "p".birthday) - CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(DATE '2026-10-09', 'MMDD') < TO_CHAR("p".birthday, 'MMDD') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS "average_completed_age" FROM "low_rbc_patients" AS "lr" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "lr".id WHERE "p".admission IN ('+', '-') GROUP BY "p".admission LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".sex, COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') GROUP BY "p".sex ORDER BY CASE "p".sex WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG("e"."aCL IgM")::NUMERIC, 2) AS "average_acl_igm" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".diagnosis ILIKE '%SJS%' AND "p".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%SJS susp%' AND "e"."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL AND "e"."aCL IgM" <> 0 LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "e".id) FROM "examination" AS "e" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "p".sex = 'F' AND "e".diagnosis ILIKE '%SjS%' AND "e".diagnosis NOT ILIKE '%suspect%' LIMIT 501
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' AND "l".rnp IN ('negative', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "p".id) FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN "laboratory" AS "l" ON "l".id = "p".id INNER JOIN "examination" AS "e" ON "e".id = "p".id WHERE "l".sm IN ('negative', '0') AND "e".thrombosis = 0 AND "l"."U-PRO" IN ('30', '100', '300', '>=300', '>=1000', '+1(30)', '+2(100)') LIMIT 501

SELECT "p".id FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rbc IS NOT NULL AND (rbc <= 3.5 OR rbc >= 6.0) GROUP BY id) AS "abnormal_rbc" ON "abnormal_rbc".id = "p".id INNER JOIN (SELECT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IS NOT NULL AND rnp <> '0' AND rnp <> 'negative' GROUP BY id) AS "positive_rnp" ON "positive_rnp".id = "p".id WHERE "p".admission = '-' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(DATE '2026-10-09', "p".birthday)))::NUMERIC, 1) AS "average_age_years" FROM "patient" AS "p" INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM "laboratory" WHERE rnp IN ('64', '256')) AS "qualifying" ON "qualifying".id = "p".id WHERE "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday > DATE '1956-10-09' LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex = 'F') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "p".sex IN ('F', 'M')), 0), 1) AS "women_percentage" FROM "patient" AS "p" WHERE "p".birthday >= DATE '1936-01-01' AND "p".birthday < DATE '1957-01-01' AND "p".sex IN ('F', 'M') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "laboratory" AS "l" WHERE "l".id = "p".id AND "l".cpk >= 250) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "l".id) AS "patient_count" FROM "laboratory" AS "l" INNER JOIN "patient" AS "p" ON "p".id = "l".id WHERE "l".date >= DATE '1981-01-01' AND "l".date < DATE '1987-01-01' AND "p".birthday IS NOT NULL AND "p".birthday > "l".date - INTERVAL '50 years' AND "l".plt BETWEEN 100 AND 400 AND "l"."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL AND "l"."U-PRO" NOT IN ('-', '0') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS "average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT("a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'o') AS "oxygen_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id FROM "bond" WHERE bond_type = '-') AS "single_bond_molecules" ON "single_bond_molecules".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_oxygen_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS "average_single_bonds_per_molecule" FROM (SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "single_bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '-' GROUP BY "m".molecule_id) AS "molecule_single_bonds" LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' GROUP BY "a".element HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(element_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "element_count" FROM "atom" AS "a2" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m2" ON "a2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "m2".label = '-' GROUP BY "a2".element) AS "counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'i') AS "iodine_atoms", COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 's') AS "sulfur_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '-' AND "a".element IN ('i', 's') LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'f')) / COUNT(*), 2) AS "percentage_no_fluorine" FROM "molecule" AS "m" WHERE "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, CASE WHEN "m".label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic" FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".molecule_id = 'TR010' GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE ("a1".element = 'p' AND "a2".element = 'n') OR ("a1".element = 'n' AND "a2".element = 'p') LIMIT 501
SELECT DISTINCT "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "connected" AS "c" WHERE "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '#') AND "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "a2".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a2" WHERE "a2".element IN ('p', 'br')) LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'cl') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 4) AS "percentage_chlorine_atoms" FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".molecule_id IN (SELECT "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" WHERE "b".bond_type = '-') LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "a".element = 'h')::NUMERIC / COUNT(*) AS "hydrogen_fraction", "m".label AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR006' GROUP BY "m".label LIMIT 501

WITH "molecule_groups" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, CASE WHEN COUNT("b".bond_id) > 0 AND BOOL_AND("b".bond_type = '-') THEN 'all_single' ELSE 'other' END AS "bond_group" FROM "molecule" AS "m" LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id GROUP BY "m".molecule_id, "m".label) SELECT bond_group, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '+') - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE label = '-') AS "carcinogenic_minus_non_carcinogenic" FROM "molecule_groups" GROUP BY bond_group ORDER BY CASE bond_group WHEN 'all_single' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "total_carbon_carbon_double_bond_pairs" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".bond_type = '=' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' LIMIT 501

WITH "plus_atoms" AS (SELECT "a".atom_id, "a".molecule_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+'), "bonded_atom_ids" AS (SELECT atom_id AS "atom_id" FROM "connected" UNION ALL SELECT atom_id2 AS "atom_id" FROM "connected"), "bonded_counts" AS (SELECT "pa".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "pa".atom_id) AS "bonded_atom_count" FROM "plus_atoms" AS "pa" INNER JOIN "bonded_atom_ids" AS "bi" ON "bi".atom_id = "pa".atom_id GROUP BY "pa".element), "total" AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM "plus_atoms") SELECT "bc".element, ROUND("bc".bonded_atom_count * 100.0 / "t".atom_count, 2) AS "percentage_of_all_plus_atoms" FROM "bonded_counts" AS "bc" CROSS JOIN "total" AS "t" WHERE "bc".bonded_atom_count = (SELECT MAX(bonded_atom_count) FROM "bonded_counts") LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".molecule_id, CASE "m".label WHEN '+' THEN 'YES' WHEN '-' THEN 'NO' END AS "carcinogenic", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bonds" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "a".molecule_id WHERE "a".atom_id = 'TR041_10' GROUP BY "a".molecule_id, "m".label LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type, COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a1".element = 'c' AND "a2".element = 'c' GROUP BY "b".bond_type ORDER BY "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a1".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 WHEN "a2".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id END) AS "count_atoms_bonded_to_chlorine" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "c".atom_id = "a1".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id WHERE "a1".element = 'cl' OR "a2".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c".atom_id2) FROM "atom" AS "s" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "s".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "s".atom_id WHERE "s".element = 's' AND "m".label = '+' LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "b".bond_id, "b".molecule_id FROM "bond" AS "b" INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "b".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "b".molecule_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT "a".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "a" WHERE "a".element IN (SELECT element FROM "atom" GROUP BY element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1)) ORDER BY "b".molecule_id ASC, "b".bond_id ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id AND "a".element = 'n' WHERE "m".molecule_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT "an".molecule_id FROM "atom" AS "an" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "an".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "an".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "an".element = 'n' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#')) LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN "a".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id2 WHEN "a2".element = 'cl' THEN "c".atom_id END) AS "count_atoms_bonded_to_chlorine" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "c".atom_id2 = "a2".atom_id WHERE "a".element = 'cl' OR "a2".element = 'cl' LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".label, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT "m".molecule_id) / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "m2".molecule_id) FROM "molecule" AS "m2" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b2" ON "b2".molecule_id = "m2".molecule_id WHERE "b2".bond_type = '#'), 2) AS "percent" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "m".label ORDER BY "m".label ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "m".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "c".bond_id) AS "bond_count" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "m".label = '+' AND "a".element IN (SELECT element FROM "atom" GROUP BY element HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) = 1) GROUP BY "m".molecule_id ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 501

WITH "atom_counts" AS (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'c') AS "carbon_atom_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE element = 'cl') AS "chlorine_atom_count" FROM "atom" GROUP BY molecule_id), "bond_counts" AS (SELECT molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS "bond_count", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE bond_type IN ('=', '#')) AS "multiple_bond_count" FROM "bond" GROUP BY molecule_id), "carbon_bond_counts" AS (SELECT "b".molecule_id, COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) FILTER (WHERE "a1".element = 'c' OR "a2".element = 'c') AS "carbon_touching_bond_count" FROM "bond" AS "b" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 GROUP BY "b".molecule_id), "ranked" AS (SELECT "m".molecule_id, "m".label, "ac".atom_count, COALESCE("bc".bond_count, 0) AS "bond_count", "ac".carbon_atom_count, "ac".chlorine_atom_count, COALESCE("cbc".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) AS "carbon_touching_bond_count", COALESCE("bc".multiple_bond_count, 0) AS "multiple_bond_count", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY COALESCE("cbc".carbon_touching_bond_count, 0) DESC, "ac".atom_count DESC, "m".molecule_id ASC) AS "rank_position" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom_counts" AS "ac" ON "ac".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "bond_counts" AS "bc" ON "bc".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "carbon_bond_counts" AS "cbc" ON "cbc".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "ac".carbon_atom_count > 0) SELECT rank_position, molecule_id, label, atom_count, bond_count, carbon_atom_count, chlorine_atom_count, carbon_touching_bond_count, multiple_bond_count FROM "ranked" ORDER BY rank_position ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "c"."bond_id") AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "c"."bond_id" = "b"."bond_id" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "ay" ON "ay"."element" = 'y' INNER JOIN "atom" AS "ah" ON "ah"."element" = 'h' INNER JOIN "connected" AS "cy" ON ("cy"."atom_id" = "ay"."atom_id" OR "cy"."atom_id2" = "ay"."atom_id") INNER JOIN "connected" AS "ch" ON ("ch"."atom_id" = "ah"."atom_id" OR "ch"."atom_id2" = "ah"."atom_id") WHERE "ay"."molecule_id" = "ah"."molecule_id" AND "b"."molecule_id" = "ay"."molecule_id" AND "c"."bond_id" = "ch"."bond_id" LIMIT 501

SELECT ROUND(AVG(atom_bond_count), 2) FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, COUNT("c".bond_id) AS "atom_bond_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".atom_id) AS "atom_counts" LIMIT 501

SELECT "other_atom".element, COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM "connected" AS "c" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "carbon_atom" ON "carbon_atom".atom_id = "c".atom_id INNER JOIN "atom" AS "other_atom" ON "other_atom".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id INNER JOIN "molecule" AS "m" ON "m".molecule_id = "carbon_atom".molecule_id WHERE "carbon_atom".element = 'c' AND "m".label = '-' AND "b".bond_type IN ('=', '#') GROUP BY "other_atom".element ORDER BY "other_atom".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "b".bond_type AS "bond_kind", COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) AS "bond_count", COUNT(DISTINCT (LEAST("a1".element, "a2".element) || '|' || GREATEST("a1".element, "a2".element))) AS "element_pair_count", CASE "m".label WHEN '+' THEN 'carcinogenic' WHEN '-' THEN 'not carcinogenic' END AS "carcinogenicity_label" FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id LEFT JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".bond_id = "b".bond_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a1" ON "a1".atom_id = "c".atom_id LEFT JOIN "atom" AS "a2" ON "a2".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "m".molecule_id = 'TR377' AND "b".bond_type IN ('-', '=') GROUP BY "b".bond_type, "m".label ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT "b".bond_id) DESC, "b".bond_type ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT DISTINCT "m".molecule_id FROM "molecule" AS "m" INNER JOIN "atom" AS "a" ON "a".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".molecule_id = "m".molecule_id WHERE "m".label = '-' AND "a".element IN ('na', 'k', 'ca', 'cu', 'zn', 'sn', 'pb', 'mg', 'li') AND "b".bond_type = '-' ORDER BY "m".molecule_id ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT element, COUNT(*) AS "atom_count" FROM (SELECT "a".atom_id, "a".element FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id OR "c".atom_id2 = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id GROUP BY "a".atom_id, "a".element HAVING BOOL_OR("b".bond_type = '-') AND NOT BOOL_OR("b".bond_type IN ('=', '#'))) AS "qualifying_atoms" GROUP BY element ORDER BY element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".molecule_id) AS "molecule_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "c".atom_id = "a".atom_id INNER JOIN "bond" AS "b" ON "b".bond_id = "c".bond_id WHERE "b".bond_type = '#' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, "a".element ASC LIMIT 501

SELECT "a".element, COUNT(DISTINCT "a".atom_id) AS "bonded_atom_count" FROM "atom" AS "a" INNER JOIN "connected" AS "c" ON "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id OR "a".atom_id = "c".atom_id2 WHERE "a".molecule_id = 'TR397' GROUP BY "a".element ORDER BY "a".element ASC LIMIT 501
